༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi gsang ba gsol gdab dang mnga' gsol gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi gsang ba gsol gdab dang mnga' gsol gyi rim pa bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gsang ba gsol gdab dang mnga' gsol bya bar spro na/ gtor ma la zan dang sman raka bran/ tshil chen gyi mar me sbar/ sha chen gu gul dang bsres pa'i dud pa btang*/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo// lan gsum bya/ sngon tshe 'das pa'i dus su rgyal ba klu'i rigs mchog /ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus su mgon po kun tu gzigs pa/ da lta thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mos pa rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs pa'i rgyal po dang zhing 'dir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhes/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid dmigs med zhi ba snying rje chen po las ma g.yos bzhin du/ 'chi bdag gi bdud gshin rje la sogs pa dregs pa can gdul dka' ba thams cad 'dul ba'i slad du/ gti mug rnam dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid/ mchog gsum dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ thugs rje dang phrin las 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba/ 'phags pa'i rgyal po rdo rje khro bo chen po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyal po tshe'i bdag po chen po/ 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes kyi rang bzhin sbyor dang sgrol ba'i yum chen khro mo/ nga rgyal dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang bzhin sras mchog ya ma rā tsa/ zhe sdang dag pa me long ye shes kyi rang bzhin sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po/ phrag dog dag pa bya grub ye shes kyi rang bzhin gsung sprul srog bdag nag po/ gza' klu sa bdag gdug pa'i gnyen po mkha' lding bya khyung rgyal po/ de dag gi 'khor tshogs gshin rje lha ma srin sde brgyad 'chi bdag srog bdag dam can dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/

sngags 'chang dam ldan mos pa'i bu la mkhyen gzigs dgongs su gsol/ sngags 'chang dam gtsang bdag gi sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ gus pas bshams pa'i dam rdzas sman raka gtor mchod 'dod yon gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di rnams 'bul gyis tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rnams dus 'dir dgongs par mdzod la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum kyi dbu 'phang mtho ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos mi nub cing 'phel ba dang*/ dge 'dun rnams chos bzhin spyod cing thugs mthun pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde skyid dpal 'byor la longs spyod cing 'khor ba las grol te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa dang*/ bdag gi nad gdon bar gcod 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ mos bzhis khams gsum pa'i chos nor skye dgu thams cad dbang du 'du ba dang*/ gnod byed dgra gdon byad ma mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ byad phur gtad mnan ngan sngags bsam sbyor ngan rtsub thams cad byed pa po kho rang la phar bzlog cing gshed du phab pa la sogs pa gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad sogs thun mong gi dngos grub rnams 'bad med bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub cing lam rim pa gnyis nyams su len pa la bar gcod dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te/ myur ba nyid du zung 'jug sku lnga'i bdag nyid 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mgon po kun tu gzigs kyi go 'phang thob pa dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar du tshe rabs thams cad du ngan song gsum du mi skye zhing bde 'gro mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa kho na thob pa dang*/ de dag kyang sdig las ldog ste dge ba'i las lam kho na la 'jug cing lam rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len la brtson pa mthar phyin pa dang*/

skye ba kun tu skyabs mchog lhag pa'i lha khyod nyid dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing rjes su bzung nas phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin nas rdul bral mchog gi zhing du mgon po kun tu gzigs pa'i spyan sngar de'i sras kyi thu bo dam par 'gyur ba sogs mdor na bdag gi bsam don thams cad 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol lo/ dza ya dza ya/ sid+dhi sid+dhi/ pha la pha la hoḥ lan gsum gsol/ de nas mnga' gsol ba ni/ rdza rnga brdung*/ rkang gling 'bud/ bshug pa'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas 'di skad do// hūm̐ e/ chos dbyings mnyam nyid ngang nyid las/ */dus mthar gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir/ */khro chen 'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad pa// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis mnon/ */sku mdog mthing nag mtshan dpes brjid// ma rig 'joms par mnga' gsol lo/ */g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa ni// klu 'bum 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// g.yon zhal dmar la gshe ba ni// gnyan khri 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa ni// sa bdag stong 'dul mnga' gsol lo// dbu gtsug khyung nag lding ba ni// gza' skar gdon 'joms mnga' gsol lo// dbu la thod skam lnga lngas brgyan// bdag lta 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// spyan dgu sdang mig dmar la 'khrugs// btsan the'u 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// snyan gong sbrul nag 'khyug pas mtshan// 'og gdon 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// zhal ni rngam bgrad dgu dang ldan// khro tshogs 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// mche ba bcu gnyis gtsigs pa ni// 'chi bdag 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa ni// dug gsum gcod par mnga' gsol lo// ā ra li yi sgra sgrog pa// sde brgyad 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// smin ma sma ra me ltar 'bar// bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol lo// dbu skra kham ser srid rtser 'phyo// rgyal kun mchod par mnga' gsol lo// phyag drug bar snang gdengs pa ni// rgyud drug sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo// mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa ni// zhe sdang gcod mdzad mnga' gsol lo// so ldan lpags pa mnabs pa ni| |gti mug 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// mi lpags sked la dkris pa ni// 'dod chags grol bar mnga' gsol lo// stag gi sham thabs grol ba ni// nga rgyal 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// lto 'gro rnam lngas brgyan pa ni// phrag dog sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo// zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bgrad pa ni// bsdu bzhis 'gro 'dul mnga' gsol lo// thod pa'i mgur chu byas pa ni// 'jig lta gzhom par mnga' gsol lo// thod rlon do shal byas pa ni// 'du byed gnas 'joms mnga' gsol lo// thal zhag rak+tas spras pa ni// rnam rtog 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// sprul pa'i pho nya spro ba ni// 'gro kun 'dren par mnga' gsol lo// las kyi gshin rjes bskor ba ni// dgra bgegs sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo// me ri me dpu+ung nang bzhugs pa// las nyon sreg par mnga' gsol lo// thugs kar 'khor lo 'bar ba ni// srid kun mthar byed mnga' gsol lo// rtsibs nang 'jam dpal bzhugs pa ni| |ye shes mchog stsol mnga' gsol lo// lte bar rat+na'i mchod rten ni// mi mthun phyogs 'joms mnga' gsol lo// bum nang rdo rje rtse lnga pa// ye shes lnga rdzogs mnga' gsol lo// de nang sa bon srung sngags bskor// phrin las rdzogs par mnga' gsol lo// bsrung bya'i ming dang 'dod gsol bcas// sngags 'chang bsrung bar mnga' gsol lo// res 'ga' rtsibs nang 'jam dpal khro// dgra gdon zlog par mnga' gsol lo// nyi zla thal rdeb dmod par bcas// byad ma gsod par mnga' gsol lo// pad+ma nyi zla'i steng bzhugs pa// sems can re skong mnga' gsol lo// ma he chu glang gis bteg pa// dregs can kun 'dul mnga' gsol lo// gshin rje pho mo brdzis pa ni// bdud bzhi 'joms par mnga' gsol lo// g.yon du sbyor sgrol yum dang bcas// mo rgyud 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// g.yas su sras mchog khro zhing rngam// pho rgyud 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo| |mdun na sku sprul lcags chas bsgyings// 'chi bdag 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// rgyab tu gsung sprul rlung dmar zhon// srog bdag 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo// 'khor tshogs ma gshin dregs par bcas// las kun sgrub par mnga' gsol lo// byang chen pū ri 'od 'bar ba// thugs dbang thob par mnga' gsol lo// bsrung ba'i gur khang bcu gsum ldan| |sa lam bgrod par mnga' gsol lo// srung byed khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// bar gcod zlog par mnga' gsol lo// phyi nang gsang mchod mkho dgur ldan// longs spyod spel bar mnga' gsol lo// sman raka gtor ma ga ṇar bcas// thugs dam skong bar mnga' gsol lo// rang sems ting 'dzin spros dang bral// bdag don sgrub par mnga' gsol lo// lus ngag lha sngags gdod nas grub// gzhan don sgrub par mnga' gsol lo// rtag tu khyod sgrub lam la brtson// skye kun rjes 'dzin mnga' gsol lo// phrin las sbyor kha'i las la 'bad| |bsgral nas 'dren par mnga' gsol lo// khyod kyi thugs rje'i mthu stobs kyis// gang bsam 'grub par mnga' gsol lo// lhag pa'i lha mchog gshin rje'i gshed// dus rnams kun tu bdag sgrub kyi// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong gi// bdag 'dod 'bras kun bsgrub pa'i phyir// rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum// dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas| |yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i// srung mar bcas kun rab 'dus par// lha mchog khyod nyid mnga' gsol lo// skyabs kun 'dus par gzi byin skyed// des na khyod kyi thugs rje'i stobs// bskyed pa'i dus la bab pa na// mkhyen nam gzigs sam gshin rje'i gshed// re zhing ltos so lhag pa'i lha// bdag gis dus kun khyod sgrub na// thugs rjes mi gzigs cang srid dam// mos ldan sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag

/'gal rkyen 'phrang las bsgral du gsol// mi mthun rkyen las bsrung du gsol// nad gdon bgegs las bskyab tu gsol// bar gcod bdud las rgyal du gsol// byad phur rbod gtong bzlog tu gsol// dgra gdon byad ma bsad du gsol// mdor na bdag yid gang smon zhing*// gang 'dod re 'bras gang mchis pa'i// bsam don 'bad med dus 'di ru// lha mchog khyod kyis rab stsol bar// grub par mdzod cig sid+dhi ku ru// zhes mnga' gsol zhing gang 'dod pa'i don rnams kyang gsol gdab smon lam du bya'o// 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gsang ba gsol gdab mnga' gsol dang bcas pa 'di/ gshin rje khro chu dug sdong la gsang ba gsol gdab mnga' gsol dang bcas pa gong ma rnams kyis mdzad 'dug pas 'dir yang mi 'thad pa ma yin pa nyid du mthong nas 'di nyid la lhag pa'i lhar byed pa/ dus mtha'i sngags 'chang 'bri gung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes/ sa yos dbo zla'i dmar po'i bzang po gnyis par mtshams mal gyi thun mtshams su lhag pa'i bsam pa kho nas sbyar ba dag go// //sid+dhi rastu//
